requirement_text: at the University of Copenhagen all bachelor programmes are taught in Danish and require the highest level in Danish or documentation for academic language skills in Danish

researcher_notes: The single most consequential fact about UCPH for ORYN's user base, and the one a ranking-derived record would never carry. UCPH is a top-100 university with zero English-taught bachelor's entry. An advisor that surfaces it as a target for a student with no Danish is giving a confidently wrong recommendation.

requirement_text: You are only eligible for admission through quota 1 if your upper secondary education is from within the EU or you have an International Baccalaureate (IB) or an European Baccalaureate (EB). Furthermore, you are not eligible for admission via quota 1 if you have a vocational secondary education.
source_authority_note: ku.dk is the official domain of the University of Copenhagen (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.ku.dk). Danish national domain; fails looksOfficial()'s suffix test. Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
researcher_notes: The Danish quota system is a shape the corpus has not held: not one admission standard with exceptions, but two parallel routes whose availability is decided by the applicant's country and qualification type, not by the applicant.

requirement_text: If you have a foreign exam where it is possible to convert your grade point average (GPA) into a Danish GPA (only scandinavian and EU/EEA countries), your converted GPA must be 6.0 or higher if you want to apply in quota 1. ... If your converted GPA is 5.9 or less, it is not possible to be assessed in quota 1 and you can only apply through quota 2.
source_authority_note: ku.dk is the official domain of the University of Copenhagen (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.ku.dk). Danish national domain; fails looksOfficial()'s suffix test. Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: The 6.0 threshold is on the Danish 7-point scale AFTER an official conversion that is only defined for Scandinavian and EU/EEA qualifications. Comparing a raw foreign GPA against 6.0 is meaningless, and for non-EU/EEA qualifications the conversion does not exist at all, so the threshold is not merely unmet -- it is undefined. Must evaluate to needs_manual_review, never not_met.
researcher_notes: A threshold whose scale is a national conversion the student cannot self-compute. Same family as the TOEFL scale problem in scalar-thresholds-are-not-enough.md, but the missing qualifier here is a country-scoped conversion table rather than a test version.

requirement_text: If you are applying in quota 1, your application is exclusively based on your GPA from your original or first given exam certificate/diploma.
source_authority_note: ku.dk is the official domain of the University of Copenhagen (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.ku.dk). Danish national domain; fails looksOfficial()'s suffix test. Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: Named provenance exclusion in the same family as Koc's superscore rule: an improved GPA from a retaken or reissued certificate is not the number used. Two students with an identical current GPA get different outcomes depending on which certificate it came from, which a threshold comparison cannot see.

requirement_text: The quota 2-proces at the University of Copenhagen consists of a quota 2-test and a quota 2-interview. ... The quota 2-test is in Danish. ... Applicants who have not participated and passed the quota 2-test will not be considered for admission.
source_authority_note: ku.dk is the official domain of the University of Copenhagen (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.ku.dk). Danish national domain; fails looksOfficial()'s suffix test. Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
researcher_notes: Quota 2 is the ONLY route for applicants with non-EU/EEA, non-Nordic qualifications, and it is gated on a test conducted in Danish. The two facts compound: the language barrier sits on the admission process itself, not only on the degree.

requirement_text: Applicants with other foreign upper secondary (high) school examinations are evaluated on the basis of a Danish quota 2 test and interview.

researcher_notes: Read with the Nordic Treaty and EU/EEA rows: UCPH applies three different recognition regimes by origin of qualification.

requirement_text: Based on the Nordic Treaty on Recognition of Qualifications and Access to Higher Education, Nordic applicants are evaluated for admission on equal terms as applicants with a Danish upper secondary school examination - both in quota 1 and quota 2.
source_authority_note: ku.dk is the official domain of the University of Copenhagen (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.ku.dk). Danish national domain; fails looksOfficial()'s suffix test. Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
researcher_notes: Recognition here derives from a treaty, not from an institutional policy. UCPH cannot vary it, which makes the treaty the authority and the university page a restatement.

requirement_text: Applicants with an International Baccalaureate (IB) or European Baccalaureate examination are evaluated for admission on equal terms as applicants with a Danish upper secondary school examination - both in quota 1 and quota 2.

researcher_notes: IB/EB is treated as domestic-equivalent regardless of where it was taken -- the one route by which a non-European student reaches quota 1.

deadline_text_verbatim: If you have a non-Danish exam you can apply for admission via quota 1 and quota 2 before the 15 March at 12:00.
source_authority_note: ku.dk is the official domain of the University of Copenhagen (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.ku.dk). Danish national domain; fails looksOfficial()'s suffix test. Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: Day, month and time of day are published; the year is not. Recorded with a null date rather than a synthesised one.
researcher_notes: Note the time component is load-bearing and is NOT midnight -- an applicant working to an end-of-day assumption loses twelve hours. Denmark publishes noon deadlines throughout; Sweden publishes midnight CET. Dating convention really is per-institution.

deadline_text_verbatim: You need to fulfil the admission requirements no later than the 5 July at 12:00 the year you apply.

researcher_notes: Requirements may be completed after the application deadline -- the two dates gate different things. Collapsing them into one 'deadline' would misstate both.
